MIND. [1] [Ambr.]
Memory impaired.
Comprehension slow, has to read everything three or four times, and then does not understand it.
Is not able to reflect upon anything properly, feels stupid. θ Often indicated in old age.
Difficult thinking in morning. θ Old people.
Distorted images, grimaces ; diabolical faces crowd upon his fancy.
Melancholy, sits for days weeping ; with great weakness, loss of muscular power and pain in small of back with constipation.
After business embarrassment cannot sleep, must get up.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Ambr.]
Vertigo with feeling of weight on vertex ; < after sleep.
Had to lie down on account of vertigo and feeling of weakness in stomach.
Great weakness in head with vertigo.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Ambr.]
Falling off of hair.
On right side of head, a spot, where hair when touched pains, as if sore.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Ambr.]
Roaring and whistling in ears, in afternoon.
Deafness of one ear.
Hearing decreases ; with cold sensation in abdomen.
Music aggravates cough.
Listening to music brings on congestion to head.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Ambr.]
Dried blood gathered in nose.
Bleeding of nose early in morning.
Copious nosebleed early in bed, several successive days. θ Old lady.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Ambr.]
Ranula.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Ambr.]
Fetor of mouth, worse mornings. θ Whooping cough.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Ambr.]
Sensation of rawness in region of velum pendulum palati.
Sore throat after exposure to a draught of air ; stitching from throat into right ear ; pains particularly from motion of tongue.
Accumulation of greyish phlegm in throat, which is difficult to hawk up, accompanied by rawness.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Ambr.]
After eating : cough and gagging ; anxiety ; pressure in pit of stomach, as if food stuck and would not go down.
Aggravation from warm drinks, especially from warm milk.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Ambr.]
Belching with and after cough.
Eructations either empty, sour or bitter.
Eructations with cough, so as almost to cause choking.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Ambr.]
Pressure in stomach and hypochondria. θ Whooping cough.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Ambr.]
Pain in right hypochondriac region, > while lying upon it.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Ambr.]
Sensation of coldness in abdomen.
Coldness of one side of abdomen (l.) ; also with deafness.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Ambr.]
Constipation. θ Whooping cough. θ Melancholy.
Frequent ineffectual desire for stool ; this makes her very anxious, at this time presence of other persons becomes unbearable.
Large flow of blood with stool.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Ambr.]
Urine when emitted is clouded, yellowish brown and deposits a brownish sediment, after which urine looks clear and yellow ; coffee grounds sediment. θ Dropsy after scarlatina.
Sour smelling urine. θ Whooping cough.
During urination, burning, smarting, itching and titillation in the urethra and vulva. θ Ovaritis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Ambr.]
A man, æt. 80, gets asthma when attempting coition.
Sore rawness between thighs.
Voluptuous itching on scrotum. θ Following use of Staphis.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Ambr.]
Burning in sexual parts, with discharge of a few drops of blood.
Stitches in ovarian region, when drawing in abdomen or pressing upon it.
Discharge of blood between periods, at every little accident, at every hard stool or after a walk a little longer than usual.
Menses appear seven days before time.
Severe itching on pudenda, must rub parts.
Soreness and itching, with swelling of labia. θ Pruritus.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Ambr.]
Puerperal eclampsia.
In childbed obstinate constipation and tenesmus ; abdomen puffed, causing much anxiety ; so nervous she cannot attempt a stool in presence of other people, not even nurse.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Ambr.]
Titillation in larynx with spasmodic cough.
Titillation in throat, larynx and trachea, causing violent cough.
Itching, scraping and soreness in larynx and trachea. θ Whooping cough.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Ambr.]
Oppression felt in chest and between scapulæ ; it subsides for a short time after eating. θ Asthma.
Asthma of old people and children. θ Asthma siccum.
Asthma comes on while he is attempting coition. θ Old man.
Whistling in chest during breathing.
   

COUGH. [27] [Ambr.]
Hollow, spasmodic, barking cough ; < from talking or reading aloud.
Spasmodic cough of elderly or of emaciated persons.
Paroxysms of cough coming from deep in chest, excited by violent tickling in throat, evening without, morning with expectoration, generally of greyish white, seldom of yellow mucus, of salty or sour taste.
Violent spasmodic cough, with frequent eructations and hoarseness.
Cough only at night, produced by excessive irritation in throat.
Cough every evening with pain under left ribs, as if something was torn loose there.
Cough with emaciation.
A kind of whooping cough ; paroxysmal, but without crowing inspiration.
Deep dry cough, with accumulation of water in mouth, and subsequent rawness in throat.
Choking and vomiting when hawking up phlegm.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Ambr.]
Sensation of pressure deep in right chest ; also in left chest or in upper part of chest.
Sensation of rawness in chest.
Itching in chest. θ Whooping cough.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Ambr.]
Anxiety at heart, causing oppression of breathing, with flushes of heat ; oppression beginning in heart. θ Asthma.
Violent palpitation, with pressure in chest, as if a lump lay there, or as if the chest was stuffed up.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Ambr.]
Stiffness in small of back after sitting.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Ambr.]
The arms go to sleep when lying on them, when carrying anything in hands or at night ; with numbness, especially of left arm in rest ; tingling in thumb.
Finger nails brittle, with a very old man ; they got soft, elastic and pink.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Ambr.]
Sore and raw between thighs, and in hollow of knees.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Ambr.]
Worse after lying down. θ Pertussis.
Sweat from slightest exertion. θ Intermittent.
   

NERVES. [36] [Ambr.]
Jerks and twitches.
Infantile spasms.
Spasms and twitches in the muscular parts.
Arms and limbs "go to sleep" easily.
Great lassitude, especially mornings in bed.
Weakness : of the whole body ; of the knees, as if they would give way ; of the feet, with loss of sensation ; in the stomach, so that she must lie down.
Loss of muscular power. θ Melancholy.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Ambr.]
Cannot sleep, must get up ; worriment from business embarrassment.
Vexatious, anxious dreams and talking in sleep ; awaken frightened. θ Children.
   

FEVER. [40] [Ambr.]
Chill in forenoon, with lassitude and sleepiness ; relieved by eating. θ Intermittent fever.
Anxious flushes of heat returning every quarter hour ; most violent towards evening. θ Intermittent fever. θ Whooping cough.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Ambr.]
Cough in spasmodic paroxysms.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Ambr.]
Emaciation.
   

SKIN. [46] [Ambr.]
Itching.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Ambr.]
Children who are excitable, nervous and weak.
Nervous persons, infants or young girls.
In old age. θ Asthma. θ Colds.
Lean persons.
Old persons and children. θ Asthma.
A very old man. θ Brittle finger nails. θ Asthma when attempting coition.
